head: codex/200-concrete-authority-reconciliation-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b3] Add crash-safe authority reconciliation barrier
body:
Closes #200

## Summary
- add a sealed concrete authority reconciliation barrier that accepts only the opaque locally published #201 authority result
- persist bounded Pending, Reconciling, Checkpointed, and Published phases with exact retry caching, external checkpoint CAS, marker/view publication, and fail-closed permits
- bind node, lineage, adapter, operation, membership, committed time, receipts, result, and generation while keeping the deterministic adapter test-only
- route Polis runtime reconciliation through the sealed barrier without exposing caller-created production authority
- keep unit and integration fixtures portable across macOS and Linux using canonical checkout-local roots compatible with the storage symlink policy

## Validation
- exact focused reconciliation lane: 36/36 passed
- machine-bound semantic subassertions: 13/13 observed with exact digests
- strict focused Clippy with warnings denied: passed
- full Runtime library: 264/264 passed, zero skipped
- immutable v4 source/proof receipt, portable-path guard, and merge-safe validator: passed
- typed issue validation and doctor: passed

## Review
- independent exact-head review by `codex:/root/review_200_portable_final`: PASS, no findings
- reviewed substantive commit: `0b4887b1aa1a7f5e76f672929c45935311d5d28e`
- publication head adds typed review metadata only; the C-SDLC review guard verifies the substantive revision is unchanged

No claim is made here for #202, #203, or #204 scope.
